summary: This CSS file styles various components of a login page, including input fields, labels, and background elements.
evidence: .inputField styles the input fields with a light transparent background, blue border, and glow effect on focus.
.black styles the background of the entire page with a white box-shadow and rounded corners.
.loginPageChild styles the login page child component with a blue background and rounded corners.
.student styles the student image with a border-radius and fixed position.
.unionIcon, .unionIcon1, .unionIcon2 style the union icons with fixed positions and sizes.
.loginBox styles the login box component with a white background and rounded corners.
